channel.title: Changelog :: Unreal Metadata Editor Tags Documentation
channel.description: 1.2.0 Paste JSON You can now fill Metadata Tags Editor with data from JSON. Additionally, Ctrl + C and Ctrl + V support was added. Menu item icons Added icons to all menu entries. 1.1.0 Applying changes to multiple assets at once is now smarter and will not accidentally overwrite metadata tags. Overwrite and Append are now replaced by Clear & Overwrite and Smart Apply. Clear & Overwrite All assets end up having exactly the same properties as visible in Metadata Tags Editor.
